name: Nondetection
summary: Hides a creature, place, or object from Divination spells for 8 hours.

m.text: a pinch of diamond dust worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

stats.effect: For the duration, you hide a target that you touch from Divination spells. The target can be a willing creature, or it can be a place or an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. The target can't be targeted by any Divination spell or perceived through magical scrying sensors.
